method.algorithm: exact TreeSHAP from the boosting library (LightGBM pred_contrib, XGBoost pred_contribs)
method.output_space: raw model output = log(expected daily units) (Tweedie, log link)
method.rows: every row of each fold's 28-day test window; no sampling
method.models: rebuilt per fold from the parameters and rounds in results/metrics.json, trained on the fold's training days, and required to reproduce the recorded WRMSSE within 1e-09
method.importance: mean |SHAP| per feature; share = its fraction of the sum over features. Group importance sums a group's SHAP values per row first.

series.why_chosen: most units sold in the last 28 training days
